tasks.label: 🚀 Full Legal AI Stack
args: console.log(\"🚀 Starting Full Legal AI Stack...\"); import(\"./src/lib/integrations/comprehensive-agent-orchestration.js\").then(m => m.comprehensiveOrchestrator.initialize()).then(() => console.log(\"✅ Agent Orchestrator Ready\")); import(\"./src/lib/integrations/flashattention-multicore-bridge.js\").then(m => m.flashAttentionMulticoreBridge.initialize()).then(() => console.log(\"✅ FlashAttention2 + Multicore Bridge Ready\"));

tasks.label: Initialize Services
args: Write-Host '🔧 Initializing Legal AI Services...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '⚡ GPU: RTX 3060 Ti' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '🧠 Context7 Multicore: 8 workers' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '🤖 Agents: Claude + CrewAI + AutoGen' -ForegroundColor Magenta; Start-Sleep 2

tasks.label: 🧠 Agent Orchestration Analysis
args: import(\"./src/lib/integrations/comprehensive-agent-orchestration.js\").then(async m => { const result = await m.executeAgents(\"Analyze TypeScript errors and provide systematic fixes for legal AI application\", { agents: [\"claude\", \"crewai\", \"autogen\"], priority: \"high\", useMulticoreAnalysis: true, errorAnalysis: true }); console.log(\"🎯 Best Result:\", result.bestResult.output.substring(0, 300) + \"...\"); console.log(\"📊 System Status:\", result.systemStatus); });

tasks.label: ⚡ FlashAttention2 GPU Processing
args: import(\"./src/lib/integrations/flashattention-multicore-bridge.js\").then(async m => { console.log(\"⚡ Starting FlashAttention2 GPU Analysis...\"); const result = await m.processWithEnhancedAI(\"Legal contract analysis with indemnification clauses and liability limitations. Evidence processing for prosecution case.\", [\"contract law\", \"evidence rules\", \"liability\"], { enableGPU: true, analysisType: \"legal\", priority: \"high\", useAgentOrchestration: true }); console.log(\"🎯 Legal Analysis:\", result.legalAnalysis); console.log(\"📊 Performance:\", result.systemMetrics); console.log(\"🔧 Optimizations:\", result.performanceOptimizations); });

tasks.label: 🔍 Error Analysis with GPU Acceleration
args: import(\"./src/lib/integrations/flashattention-multicore-bridge.js\").then(async m => { console.log(\"🔍 Starting GPU-Accelerated Error Analysis...\"); const errorData = { totalErrors: 1962, categories: { svelte5_migration: 800, ui_component_mismatch: 600, css_unused: 400, binding_issues: 162 } }; const result = await m.analyzeErrorsWithGPU(errorData, [\"export let prop = default\", \"let { prop } = $props()\", \"<CardRoot class=\\\"card\\\">\", \"<DialogRoot bind:open={show}>\", \"unused .container { }\"]); console.log(\"🎯 Priority Fixes:\", result.prioritizedErrors.slice(0, 5)); console.log(\"📊 Fix Probability:\", result.fixProbability); console.log(\"🔧 Relevant Sections:\", result.relevantCodeSections.length); });

tasks.label: Monitor Ollama Status
args: while($true) { try { $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:11434/api/tags' -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Host '✅ Ollama OK' -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host '❌ Ollama offline' -ForegroundColor Red }; Start-Sleep 10 }

tasks.label: 📊 System Status Dashboard
args: import(\"./src/lib/integrations/comprehensive-agent-orchestration.js\").then(m => { console.log(\"🚀 Agent Orchestrator Status:\", JSON.stringify(m.comprehensiveOrchestrator.getSystemStatus(), null, 2)); }); import(\"./src/lib/integrations/flashattention-multicore-bridge.js\").then(m => { console.log(\"⚡ FlashAttention Bridge Status:\", JSON.stringify(m.flashAttentionMulticoreBridge.getStatus(), null, 2)); });

tasks.label: 🤖 Run Complete AI Pipeline
args: console.log(\"🤖 Starting Complete Legal AI Pipeline...\"); Promise.all([import(\"./src/lib/integrations/comprehensive-agent-orchestration.js\"), import(\"./src/lib/integrations/flashattention-multicore-bridge.js\")]).then(async ([orchestration, bridge]) => { await Promise.all([orchestration.comprehensiveOrchestrator.initialize(), bridge.flashAttentionMulticoreBridge.initialize()]); console.log(\"✅ All systems initialized\"); const analysisResult = await orchestration.analyzeAndFixErrors({ totalErrors: 1962, sampleErrors: [\"TS2322: Type mismatch\", \"Svelte component prop error\", \"CSS unused selector\"] }); console.log(\"🔧 Error Analysis Complete:\", analysisResult.errorAnalysis.recommendations.slice(0, 3)); const gpuResult = await bridge.processWithEnhancedAI(\"Comprehensive legal AI analysis with error resolution\", [\"TypeScript\", \"Svelte\", \"legal AI\"]); console.log(\"⚡ GPU Processing Complete:\", gpuResult.systemMetrics); console.log(\"🎯 Pipeline Status: All systems operational\"); });

tasks.label: 🐘 PostgreSQL: Start Database
args: Write-Host '🐘 Starting PostgreSQL Database...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; try { Start-Service postgresql-x64-16 -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host '✅ PostgreSQL started successfully' -ForegroundColor Green; } catch { Write-Host '⚠️ PostgreSQL may already be running or needs manual start' -ForegroundColor Yellow; }

tasks.label: 🔍 Qdrant: Start Vector DB
args: Write-Host '🔍 Starting Qdrant Vector Database...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; cd '../../deeds-web-app/qdrant-extracted'; Start-Process -FilePath '.\qdrant.exe' -WindowStyle Hidden; Start-Sleep 3; Write-Host '✅ Qdrant started in background' -ForegroundColor Green;

tasks.label: 🗃️ MinIO: Start Object Storage
args: Write-Host '🗃️ Starting MinIO Object Storage...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; cd '../../deeds-web-app'; if (Test-Path 'minio.exe') { Start-Process -FilePath '.\minio.exe' -ArgumentList 'server', '--address', ':9000', '--console-address', ':9001', 'data' -WindowStyle Hidden; Write-Host '✅ MinIO started on :9000 (console :9001)' -ForegroundColor Green; } else { Write-Host '⚠️ MinIO not found, please install MinIO' -ForegroundColor Yellow; }

tasks.label: 🔧 Go Services: Build All
args: Write-Host '🔧 Building Go Services...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; cd '../../deeds-web-app'; Write-Host 'Building enhanced RAG service...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; cd go-microservice; go build -o ../bin/enhanced-rag.exe .; cd ..; Write-Host 'Building upload service...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; cd go-services; go build -o ../bin/upload-service.exe .; cd ..; Write-Host '✅ Go services built successfully' -ForegroundColor Green;

tasks.label: 📊 System Health: Check All Services
args: $services = @('PostgreSQL (5432)', 'Redis (6379)', 'Qdrant (6333)', 'MinIO (9000)', 'Neo4j (7474)', 'Ollama (11434)'); Write-Host '📊 Checking System Health...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; ForEach ($service in $services) { $port = ($service -split '\(')[1] -replace '\)', ''; try { $connection = Test-NetConnection -ComputerName localhost -Port $port -InformationLevel Quiet -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; if ($connection) { Write-Host "✅ $service - Running" -ForegroundColor Green; } else { Write-Host "❌ $service - Not responding" -ForegroundColor Red; } } catch { Write-Host "❌ $service - Error checking" -ForegroundColor Red; } }

tasks.label: 🛑 Infrastructure: Stop All Services
args: Write-Host '🛑 Stopping all infrastructure services...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host 'Stopping PostgreSQL...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; try { Stop-Service postgresql-x64-16 -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}; Write-Host 'Stopping Redis...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Get-Process redis-server -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; Write-Host 'Stopping Qdrant...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Get-Process qdrant -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; Write-Host 'Stopping MinIO...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Get-Process minio -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; Write-Host 'Stopping Neo4j...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; npm run neo4j:stop; Write-Host 'Stopping RabbitMQ...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; npm run rabbitmq:stop; Write-Host 'Stopping Ollama...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Get-Process ollama -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; Write-Host '✅ All services stopped' -ForegroundColor Green;
